rca of the issue: Reproduction: opening https://ground-build-hub.preview.emergentagent.com in browser automation returns 403 and message: 'Blocked request. This host (ground-build-hub.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud) is not allowed. Add to server.allowedHosts in vite.config.js'. Root cause: preview host/domain mismatch with Vite host allowlist policy. Mitigation: add preview host(s) to Vite server.allowedHosts and verify ingress/public URL mapping to frontend service.
